shared_elements: human head with facial features (eyes, nose, mouth)
justification: Both depict human figures with faces and some animal element, but A is a narrative procession of profile figures leading a camel between framing bands of rosettes, while B is a frontal, blocky stacked composition of schematic heads/bodies with crudely incised eyes and mouth and no scene or border. The only correspondence is the universal presence of a human face and an animal, rendered with utterly different conventions (naturalistic low-relief profile vs. frontal massive schematic carving).
